hero.subtitle: Invitation-only immersive experiences for a maximum of six participants

ethos.body1: Shamanic Travels is a private, selection-based journey across the high Andes and Amazonian basins. We do not provide group tours. We curate deep experiential thresholds for those ready to encounter Peru's living wisdom traditions.
ethos.body2: Combining the logistical precision of luxury travel with the profound silence of Peru's sacred geography, every element is managed with calm authority and absolute privacy.

journeys.meta: Each journey · 21 days · Maximum six participants · Selection required
journeys.j1_desc: A cultural and geographic expedition from the Pacific coast through the high Andes — Paracas, Nazca, Arequipa, Titicaca, Palcoyo, Machu Picchu and Cusco — with ritual integration embedded along the route.
journeys.j2_desc: A structured field-based immersion deep in the Peruvian Amazon forest. River transfer from Pucallpa into remote basin territory, alternating cycles of guided traditional practice and integration.

guide.title: Marcello Buglione
guide.body1: With a foundation in strategic communication, NLP and hypnosis, and decades of international training, Marcello is more than a guide. He is the architect of the experience.
guide.body2: His evolution into immersive Peruvian journeys distils complex cultural wisdom into precise, transformative travel paths for executives, entrepreneurs and professionals operating at high altitudes of life.
guide.quote: We do not design entertainment. We design attention, presence, and experience.

apply.title: How to Join
apply.desc: These are private journeys. Each participant is carefully selected through a personal interview to ensure alignment with our values and mutual readiness. We turn away more people than we accept.
apply.s1_desc: Submit your interest. Tell us what calls you and what you hope to find.
apply.s2_desc: We speak with you privately to understand your intentions and assess readiness. This is not transactional.
apply.s3_desc: If selected, you receive detailed guidance on physical, practical, and contemplative preparation for your journey.
apply.note: Journeys depart quarterly. Next departure: Q3 2026.

testimonials.title: What They Carry Forward
testimonials.q1: In the silence of the mountains, I found myself.
testimonials.q2: Not what I expected. Far deeper. A threshold I didn't know I needed to cross.
testimonials.q3: Marcello doesn't teach. He witnesses. And somehow, that witnessing changes everything.

footer.desc: Seven chapters on the most sacred sites of the Andean world: Cusco, the Sacred Valley, Pisac, Moray, Machu Picchu, Titicaca and Tiwanaku. A guide written by someone who lives them.

blog.title: Insights
blog.desc: Reflections on shamanic traditions, the philosophy of private travel, and the living geography of Peru — written by Marcello Buglione.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.desc: Peru's sacred geography — the high Andes, the Amazonian basin, and the living landscapes that hold these traditions.

andean.hero_desc: A private cultural expedition from the Sacred Valley through the high Andes, the Amazon and the Pacific coast — twenty-one days, six participants, one curated path.
andean.premise_lead: Five chapters. Twenty-one days. Six participants. One curated path.
andean.ritual_desc: Three ritual moments are woven into the journey itself. They are guided by Marcello with trusted local practitioners, held in safe and prepared environments.
andean.closing_title: The Andean Arc opens to six participants per departure.
andean.quote:
"Not every journey changes you.
Some simply remind you who you are."
